file_id: The vs Village Fields on 18 January, 2023

sentences.text: The vs Village Fields on 18 January, 2023

Author: R. Raghunandan Rao
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Writ Petition No.1070 of 2023
Order:

The petitioners, who are said to be owners of various extents of land in Sy.No.525/2A1 and 525/2A2 of Battamdoddi Village fields, Punganur Revenue Mandal, Chittoor District have approached this Court with the complaint that the respondents 6 to 9 are excavating the joint private road, laid by them through these survey numbers, for the purpose of creating a water canal for the Handriniva Srujala Sravanthi Scheme, without their consent and against their objections.

The petitioners also complain that after having excavated the water canal through the said joint road, the respondents are now seeking to make further excavations in the agricultural fields of the petitioners, without the consent of the petitioners.

2. The learned Government Pleader for Irrigation submits that no water canals are being excavated by the Irrigation Department, without obtaining necessary consent from the farmers through whose fields such canals are being excavated.

3. In the light of the aforesaid submissions, there shall be a direction to the respondents 6 to 9, not to excavate any water canal through the lands of the petitioners, without obtaining a written permission and consent from the petitioners.

In the event of the land being required even without the consent of the petitioners, the same shall be acquired under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
before any excavation is carried out.
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

Note:
Issue CC tomorrow.
B/o RJS HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO 18.01.2023
